prompts.task: Create ./service/.observe and copy ./service/eval/inputs/otel-audit.json to ./service/.observe/otel-audit.json. Use the bundled selection flow to write ./service/.observe/otel-selection.json with requested ID OTEL-005 and its exact dependency closure, then instrument only approved OTEL-001 and OTEL-005 to reduce mean time to detect asynchronous persistence failures, search-index backpressure, and capacity eviction. Preserve the existing cmd/kvstore-server startup path and kvstore package APIs; leave unselected OTEL-002, OTEL-003, and OTEL-004 unchanged; and do not invent filesystem or platform signals the service cannot observe. Write and validate the bound canonical instrumentation and verification JSON plus compatibility reports, exercise all selected verification scenarios through emitted telemetry, and run go test -race ./... or record the exact toolchain/platform blocker.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service for resulting source, configuration, tests, and .observe reports.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Uses the bundled selection workflow rather than hand-authoring scope: .observe/otel-selection.json is the valid schema-v1 ID-only overlay emitted by that workflow, requests only OTEL-005, approves exactly OTEL-001 then OTEL-005 in canonical audit order, validates against audit ID kvstore-20260909, and leaves the copied audit baseline unchanged.

Routes this faster-detection request through the shared incident-readiness and incident-implementation guidance, follows the Go language, project-runtime-validation, and JSON approval contracts, and does not enter another language or GenAI implementation path.

Preserves cmd/kvstore-server and the kvstore package boundary while implementing the selected OTEL-001 provider/resource prerequisite exactly once with environment-driven OTLP trace and metric providers, W3C propagation, operator-preserved service identity, and graceful shutdown; it does not add a log provider/exporter/bridge or implement unselected HTTP route, correlated-log, or runtime-metric findings OTEL-002 through OTEL-004.

Implements the selected OTEL-005 detector inputs with the audited signal semantics: kvstore.persistence.operations records deterministically forced failure with bounded operation, outcome=failure, and reason; kvstore.index.queue.depth observes nonzero real queue pressure with bounded workflow; and kvstore.evictions records reason=capacity without changing persistence, indexing, or eviction behavior. An optional kvstore.persist span is localization-only and is not substituted for a missing detector metric.

Uses only state the application can observe accurately and keeps metric dimensions bounded; it does not claim filesystem capacity, durable-write success, or index freshness, and never puts keys, file paths, values, search terms, raw paths, request IDs, goroutine IDs, or error text on metrics.

Adds executable focused telemetry tests for store.async.persistence.failure, store.index.backpressure, and store.capacity.eviction that drive each incident state to a non-default value and assert emitted datapoints plus bounded dimensions through an in-memory exporter or equivalent app-code seam; registration, metric-name presence, zero-value collection, AST checks, and source-string checks are not proof.

Runs go test -race ./... after the concurrency-sensitive instrumentation and records the command and result; if the race detector cannot run, the verification remains Partial and records the exact toolchain/platform blocker rather than treating a normal go test pass as sufficient.

Writes digest-bound .observe/otel-instrumentation.json and .observe/otel-verify.json plus the compatibility Markdown/HTML reports for only OTEL-001 and OTEL-005, maps every selected scenario to evidence at its authored proof level, distinguishes MTTD-improving metrics from localization-only telemetry, and keeps any unproven runtime/export or filesystem/platform prerequisite explicit without claiming complete coverage.
